items.title: Compute Conv2d Output Shape

items.title: Build a Minimal MNIST ConvNet with Keras
items.instruction_text: Construct a compact convolutional neural network in Keras to classify handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset. Your model must include exactly two Conv2D layers (each followed by ReLU activation and MaxPooling2D), one Flatten layer, one Dense hidden layer with ReLU, and a final Dense output layer with softmax activation for 10 classes. Compile the model using categorical crossentropy loss, Adam optimizer, and track accuracy. Train it for exactly 5 epochs on the standard MNIST training set (preprocessed: normalized pixel values, one-hot encoded labels). Return the trained model object.
items.starter_code:
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers

# Load and preprocess MNIST
def load_and_preprocess_mnist():
    (x_train, y_train), (x_test, y_test) = keras.datasets.mnist.load_data()
    x_train = x_train.astype('float32') / 255.0
    x_train = x_train.reshape(-1, 28, 28, 1)
    y_train = keras.utils.to_categorical(y_train, 10)
    return x_train, y_train

x_train, y_train = load_and_preprocess_mnist()

# Build your model below — do NOT modify above
model = None  # Replace this line with your Sequential model
constraints: Use only the Keras Sequential API
Exactly two Conv2D layers (32 and 64 filters, 3×3 kernel, 'same' padding)
Train for exactly 5 epochs with batch_size=128
Use only the provided preprocessing function
items.expected_output: A fully defined and compiled Keras Sequential model object that has been trained for 5 epochs on MNIST. The submission must be the variable `model` containing the trained model.

test_cases.description: Model is an instance of keras.models.Sequential
Model has exactly 7 layers (2 Conv2D + 2 MaxPooling2D + 1 Flatten + 1 Dense + 1 Dense)
Final Dense layer has 10 units and 'softmax' activation
Model achieves ≥97.5% training accuracy after epoch 5
test_cases.notes: Tolerance accounts for minor stochastic variation; if below threshold, verify architecture and compilation

Train and evaluate a convnet on MNIST.
